CustomField.label: Absence ohne Deputy
CustomField.description: SCRUM-457 AC8: "OHNE DEPUTY" while an absence is running today or starts within the next 14 days and no deputy has been named yet — exactly the customers that get forgotten, so they stand out in the team-lead overview. Blank otherwise. Formula field, read-only.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_Start__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_End__c)) && Absence_End__c >= TODAY() && Absence_Start__c - TODAY() <= 14 && ISBLANK(Absence_Deputy__c), "OHNE DEPUTY", "")
